item.title: EplayerX 1.2.5
item.description:
## 更新日志
- 新增云盘与网络共享中的图片预览，支持切换图片、缩放和触控板浏览。 - 完善媒体库的视频与音轨信息展示，改进云盘播放、字幕识别和下载稳定性。 - 优化下载列表的选择、双击播放与批量操作，并支持设置播放截图的保存目录。 - 改进 Trakt 续播、下一集选择以及已观看状态同步。 - 优化元数据、海报与标题标志的语言设置，让首页与详情展示更一致。 - 修复播放控制、解码回退及退出播放时的稳定性问题。
需要 macOS 12.0 或更高版本，请按 Mac 芯片选择 Apple Silicon 或 Intel 安装包。
## What's New
- Added image previews for cloud drives and network shares, with image navigation, zoom, and trackpad browsing. - Improved video and audio track information in media libraries, cloud playback, subtitle recognition, and download reliability. - Refined download selection, double-click playback, and batch actions, and added a configurable folder for playback screenshots. - Improved Trakt resume, next-episode selection, and watched-state sync. - Refined metadata, poster, and title-logo language preferences for more consistent Home and detail pages. - Fixed stability issues with playback controls, decoder fallback, and exiting playback.
Requires macOS 12.0 or later. Choose the Apple Silicon or Intel download for your Mac.
